name: panda-compact
description: Compaction without a summary: Haiku, inside your own session, decides which old tool calls and results to drop; every prompt and reply stays word for word.

compactAtPercent.title: Compact at
compactAtPercent.description: Context fill (percent) at which the mod starts a compaction after a turn.

model.title: Judge model
model.description: The model that decides what to drop, as --model takes it.

keepThreshold.title: Keep threshold
keepThreshold.description: Minimum probability that a call or result is still needed; below it the item goes.

preserveRecentMessages.title: Recent messages
preserveRecentMessages.description: Newest messages never touched (the first message is always kept).

minReductionRatio.title: Minimum cut
minReductionRatio.description: Minimum share of characters removed to use the result; below it the built-in summary runs.

truncateHeadChars.title: Result head
truncateHeadChars.description: Characters kept from a result that is cut; 0 keeps only the note.

maxStateTokens.title: State tokens
maxStateTokens.description: Estimated size of the conversation sent to the judge.

maxRequestTokens.title: Request tokens
maxRequestTokens.description: Estimated size of one request, conversation plus questions.
